actual_scope: At p=19, beta0=-1/2, bandwidth 2, and t_i=i, does every principal restriction of the normalized Schur section obey the Neumann ceilings 27, 3938, and 321?

stop_rule: Stop once all 64 principal sections inherit b=3 and rho=L. Do not invert the six-by-six matrix.
